title: Do Self-Evolving Agents Forget? Capability Degradation and Preservation in Lifelong LLM Agent Adaptation
problem: Continual agent adaptation degrades previously acquired capabilities across mutable repositories.
assumption_broken: Acquiring new capabilities does not automatically preserve previously mastered tasks.
operational_signature: Adapt → measure drift → penalize disruption → retain capabilities
load_bearing_mechanism: Capability-aware retention regularization constrains updates that disrupt previously useful structures.
limitations_evident: Local theory assumes a capability-aligned preservation metric
Stability competes with adaptation
Condensed experimental description limits protocol verification

title: Empowering VLMs for Few-Shot Multimodal Time Series Classification via Tailored Agentic Reasoning
problem: Static few-shot contexts miss discriminative temporal features and cannot adapt to test-time shifts.
assumption_broken: Few-shot adaptation can optimize an explicit knowledge bank rather than model weights or a fixed prompt.
operational_signature: Classify → diagnose → verify → update knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Grounded error reflection drives atomic, gated knowledge-bank updates that avoid context collapse.
limitations_evident: Test-time pseudo-label errors may contaminate knowledge
Only three runs are stated without visible variance estimates
Baselines share shot counts but not demonstrated compute budgets

title: TacoMAS: Test-Time Co-Evolution of Topology and Capability in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Single-axis or synchronous multi-agent adaptation cannot reconcile local capability learning with stable coordination.
assumption_broken: Agent topology and capabilities should evolve jointly but need not update at the same rate.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose → refine locally → restructure slowly
load_bearing_mechanism: Fast trajectory-based memory updates alternate with slower bounded topology edits.
limitations_evident: Convergence assumes biased beneficial meta-LLM edits
LLM-judge feedback may be noisy
Meta-LLM differs from the base agents

title: Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents
problem: Embodied agents lack a reset-free mechanism for building and repairing long-horizon scaffolding online.
assumption_broken: Harness optimization need not reset episodes or leave scaffolding fixed during model learning.
operational_signature: Act → inspect failures → edit scaffolding → continue
load_bearing_mechanism: Periodic trajectory-conditioned CRUD edits update the live harness without resetting the environment.
limitations_evident: Weak models fall below the capability floor
Open-source training requires a frontier teacher
Reset-free versus reset-based training is not directly compared

title: Swarm Skills: A Portable, Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System Specification for Coordination Engineering
problem: Reusable multi-agent coordination knowledge remains trapped in framework-specific code and discarded trajectories.
assumption_broken: Coordination protocols can be portable evolving assets rather than runtime-internal configurations.
operational_signature: Distill → execute → score friction → patch and curate
load_bearing_mechanism: Portable coordination specifications carry scored evolution records that drive autonomous patching and curation.
limitations_evident: Only a qualitative travel-planning case study
No large-scale cross-host conformance tests
Initial workflow lock-in remains unresolved

title: MAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution with Co-Evolutionary Knowledge Graphs
problem: Frozen agents need structured cross-iteration experience and adaptive retrieval without updating backbone weights.
assumption_broken: Self-evolution can reside in a graph and bandit policies rather than parameters or flat feedback.
operational_signature: Collect → curate successes and corrections → adapt retrieval → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-filtered dual success/failure graph memory co-evolves with retrieval and routing bandits.

improver_modified.how: The search and routing bandits and Navigator strategies update alongside the graph from shared rewards.

limitations_evident: Depends on recurring task structure
Sensitive to curator graph-write quality
Retrieval-side theory does not guarantee arbitrary LLM improvement

title: RFAmpDesigner: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Radio Frequency Amplifier Design
problem: RF sizing requires expensive sparse-feedback search over coupled high-dimensional parameters.
assumption_broken: LLMs can optimize circuit design concepts instead of directly manipulating netlists or all sizing variables.
operational_signature: Allocate resources → compile → simulate → retrieve and refine
load_bearing_mechanism: A multi-fidelity middleware maps low-dimensional resource allocations to circuit parameters while reusable experience guides refinement.
limitations_evident: Proof of concept restricted to a prepared LNA topology
Requires process-specific expert lookup tables
No complete physical design validation is shown

title: EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
problem: Coarse trajectory-based skill rewriting corrupts valid guidance when failures are execution lapses.
assumption_broken: A failed execution does not imply that the skill itself needs correction.
operational_signature: Execute → attribute evidence → consolidate → selectively revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Skill-aware attribution separates substantive defects from execution lapses and routes the latter to a reminder appendix.
limitations_evident: Depends on correct LLM attribution of execution failures
Training compute is not visibly budget matched
Test performance is inspected across revision stages

title: EGL-SCA: Structural Credit Assignment for Co-Evolving Instructions and Tools in Graph Reasoning Agents
problem: Undifferentiated failure feedback misdirects updates between graph parsing instructions and executable solvers.
assumption_broken: Instructions and tools must be co-evolved with failure-specific credit rather than optimized independently.
operational_signature: Execute → localize first failure → repair component → retain trade-offs
load_bearing_mechanism: Structural credit assignment routes verifier diagnostics to localized instruction mutation or tool synthesis and repair.
limitations_evident: Requires typed task interfaces and structured verifiers
Single backbone in main experiments
Variance estimates are not visible in condensed text

title: Evolving-RL: End-to-End Optimization of Experience-Driven Self-Evolving Capability within Agents
problem: Noisy skill extraction and separately trained utilization prevent reliable experience-driven adaptation.
assumption_broken: The capability to extract experience should be jointly trained with the capability to use it.
operational_signature: Solve → extract candidates → evaluate transfer → jointly train
load_bearing_mechanism: Shared-policy GRPO couples skill extraction rewards to downstream utility while reusing evaluation trajectories to train the solver.

improver_modified.how: Joint reinforcement learning updates the shared extractor and solver policy parameters.

limitations_evident: Mind2Web permits skill extraction directly on the test set
Skill evaluation noise can destabilize training
Simple skill management and retrieval

title: GRAFT-ATHENA: Self-Improving Agentic Teams for Autonomous Discovery and Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms
problem: Scientific agents restart method search because prior outcomes lack explicit admissibility and dependency structure.
assumption_broken: Scientific similarity and method-selection priors can be explicitly represented rather than left implicit in text or weights.
operational_signature: Encode → retrieve structural neighbors → propose and execute → retain outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Factored scientific graphs and semantic fingerprints turn validated neighboring cases into admissibility-constrained method priors.

improver_modified.how: New scientific actions, dependencies, and solved cases expand the substrate and alter future proposal priors.

limitations_evident: Expert-curated initial semantic graphs and seed cases
Unsupported regions require human review
Selected case studies rather than uniform broad task sampling

title: EVOCHAMBER: Test-Time Co-evolution of Multi-Agent System at Individual, Team, and Population Scales
problem: Isolated memories waste cross-agent experience while symmetric broadcasting erases specialization.
assumption_broken: Multi-agent evolution must modify team organization and population knowledge flow rather than replicate single-agent memory updates.
operational_signature: Assemble → solve → contrast outcomes → route lessons and reshape pool
load_bearing_mechanism: CoDream transfers collaboratively distilled lessons asymmetrically from niche-strong agents to niche-deficient agents.

improver_modified.how: The leadership experience bank learns future collaboration choices while competence and synergy statistics adapt team selection.

limitations_evident: Uses externally provided dataset-derived niche labels
Experience archives grow without capacity limits
Equal team size does not establish equal total evolution compute

title: SAGE: A Self-Evolving Agentic Graph-Memory Engine for Structure-Aware Associative Memory
problem: Static graph retrieval misses bridge evidence and cannot improve memory construction through downstream feedback.
assumption_broken: Graph memory should jointly evolve its writing and reading rather than act as a static retrieval index.
operational_signature: Write graph → retrieve evidence → score utility → adapt writer and reader
load_bearing_mechanism: Reader-aware writing rewards couple graph construction to structure-gated associative retrieval.

improver_modified.how: GRPO trains the memory writer from reader utility while reader calibration adapts to evolved graphs.

limitations_evident: Retrieval depends on graph extraction and entity linking quality
Full training-cost details are deferred to an unavailable appendix
Evolution and evaluation separation is not explicit in supplied text

title: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
problem: Repeated textual consolidation destroys useful trajectory evidence and degrades agent performance.
assumption_broken: More consolidated experience does not necessarily produce better reusable memory.
operational_signature: Preserve episodes → choose consolidation → update stores → measure utility
load_bearing_mechanism: Keeping raw episodes and gating consolidation avoids compounding lossy rewrites.
limitations_evident: Controlled mitigation mainly tested on ARC-AGI Stream
Some regression tests intentionally reuse memory-source problems
Raw episodes require larger context than compressed lessons

title: EvolveMem:Self-Evolving Memory Architecture via AutoResearch for LLM Agents
problem: Fixed retrieval infrastructure becomes mismatched to growing heterogeneous agent memories.
assumption_broken: Retrieval scoring, fusion, and answer policies can evolve alongside stored content.
operational_signature: Evaluate → diagnose failures → propose configuration → accept or revert
load_bearing_mechanism: Per-question failure diagnosis targets retrieval configuration edits guarded by revert-on-regression and exploration safeguards.
limitations_evident: Reported benchmark questions also drive configuration evolution
MemBench main evaluation contains only 28 samples
Retrieval edits cannot recover absent memories

title: ASH: Agents that Self-Hone in Long-Horizon Worlds
problem: Fixed visuomotor policies stall as long-horizon worlds introduce underrepresented mechanics and contexts.
assumption_broken: Unlabeled internet video can supply targeted online supervision without reward shaping or action annotations.
operational_signature: Detect stagnation → retrieve demonstrations → infer actions → retrain and resume
load_bearing_mechanism: Stuck-triggered bootstrapping updates an inverse dynamics model and policy using relevant videos and salient long-term memories.

improver_modified.how: The inverse dynamics model that generates policy supervision is retrained on newly collected trajectories.

limitations_evident: Requires relevant internet demonstrations
Ambiguous pixel-to-action inference limits pseudo-labels
Only 2D discrete-action environments evaluated

title: Learning to Build the Environment: Self-Evolving Reasoning RL via Verifiable Environment Synthesis
problem: Fixed verified curricula saturate while self-labeled synthetic tasks provide unstable rewards.
assumption_broken: The reusable training unit can be a validated executable environment rather than an individual generated problem.
operational_signature: Synthesize → validate and calibrate → sample and score → jointly optimize
load_bearing_mechanism: Compile-once solve-many environments preserve solve-verify asymmetry while difficulty and novelty gates maintain informative rewards.

improver_modified.how: A shared GRPO policy jointly improves environment generation and task solving; accepted environments seed future generation.

limitations_evident: Semantic correctness still relies on same-policy review
Ten handcrafted seed environments constrain the starting space
Single-run evaluation for several benchmarks

title: DrugSAGE:Self-evolving Agent Experience for Efficient State-of-the-Art Drug Discovery
problem: Drug-model agents repeat expensive architecture and training search independently for every new task.
assumption_broken: Validated search solutions, edits, and failure fixes can eliminate rather than merely accelerate new-task search.
operational_signature: Validate skills → search with experience → store outcomes → route reusable solutions
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-task solution, refinement, and execution memories guide MCTS or directly transfer verified pipelines with no target-task search.

improver_modified.how: Refinement and execution memories change future edit proposals, family selection, and automatic repairs.

limitations_evident: Evaluation is concentrated in molecular property prediction
Skill prioritization uses popularity-based priors
Baseline budgets follow agent-specific definitions

title: TopoEvo: A Topology-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices
problem: Noisy multimodal telemetry and topology drift cause agents to confuse amplified downstream symptoms with initiating faults.
assumption_broken: Salient anomaly evidence is not sufficient without topology-constrained propagation checks and adaptive representations.
operational_signature: Encode and discretize → hypothesize → verify propagation → refresh and adapt
load_bearing_mechanism: Topology-grounded symptom tokens support hypothesis-evidence-test reasoning, with incident-memory refresh and conservative pseudo-label adaptation.
limitations_evident: Topology faithfulness does not establish intervention-level causality
Pseudo-label adaptation can drift
Broader platform heterogeneity remains unevaluated

title: H-Mem: A Novel Memory Mechanism for Evolving and Retrieving Agent Memory via a Hybrid Structure
problem: Single-index memories cannot jointly support temporal consolidation and entity-centered multi-hop evidence retrieval.
assumption_broken: Memory retrieval need not choose between temporal abstraction trees and relational graphs.
operational_signature: Extract → consolidate by time and meaning → traverse relations → retrieve and refine evidence
load_bearing_mechanism: A coupled temporal-semantic tree and entity graph supports both long-term abstraction and multi-hop retrieval.
limitations_evident: Higher indexing token cost and storage than simpler memories
Only textual memory QA evaluated
Real-world agent deployment remains future work

title: Agentic Discovery of Neural Architectures: AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design
problem: Human architecture design and rigid search overlook efficient primitive arrangements and new mechanisms.
assumption_broken: LLM agents can search architecture arrangements and implement primitives instead of relying on fixed NAS operators.
operational_signature: Draft → train proxy → inspect fitness → improve and scale
load_bearing_mechanism: Agent-generated architectural hypotheses are iteratively refined through executable proxy evaluation and greedy search.
limitations_evident: Small-scale proxy rankings may not predict larger models
Aggregation and extrapolation remain non-agentic
Proxy test scores are used in architecture aggregation

title: FORGE: Self-Evolving Agent Memory With No Weight Updates via Population Broadcast
problem: Isolated reflection accumulates unreliable memory and heavy-tailed failures in stochastic decision-making.
assumption_broken: Gradient-free agent learning needs population-level selection rather than only better single-stream reflections.
operational_signature: Fail → reflect → checkpoint → broadcast champion and freeze graduates
load_bearing_mechanism: Between-stage champion memory broadcast propagates rare useful discoveries while graduation conserves compute.
limitations_evident: Only CAGE-2 B-line at a 30-step horizon
Single-episode champion probes can misalign with final performance
Best-only destructive broadcast sacrifices diversity

title: ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning
problem: Episodic recovery does not remove recurring failures rooted in unrepaired symbolic operator definitions.
assumption_broken: Durable adaptation can directly edit typed process knowledge rather than prompts, memories, or weights.
operational_signature: Localize fault → synthesize typed patch → verify and canary → commit with rollback
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-driven acquisition installs governed symbolic operator repairs that prevent same-root recurrence.
limitations_evident: Synthetic recurring faults rather than production logs
No cross-sibling transfer under renamed schemas
Adaptation horizons are short

title: SE-GA: Memory-Augmented Self-Evolution for GUI Agents
problem: Static GUI policies and limited interaction histories impede long-horizon execution and reuse of successful experience.
assumption_broken: Retrieved interaction memories can become training data for the underlying GUI policy rather than remaining temporary inference context.
operational_signature: Retrieve context → execute actions → curate experience → train policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical test-time memory supplies curated trajectories to memory-aware supervised training and token-level GRPO.
limitations_evident: Some baseline results are imported from prior work
Training sources overlap evaluation dataset families without a visible split audit
No visible multi-seed uncertainty reporting

title: MemRepair: Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Repository-Level Vulnerability Repair
problem: Repository-level repair agents repeat semantic mistakes without persistent historical fixes and failure-to-success experience.
assumption_broken: Validation feedback can be retained as reusable repair knowledge rather than discarded after each attempt.
operational_signature: Retrieve experience → localize defect → generate and validate → retain repair lessons
load_bearing_mechanism: A three-tier repair memory combines project-specific fixes, security patterns, and correction trajectories to guide runtime-feedback refinement.
limitations_evident: Online benchmark-derived memories complicate independent evaluation
Test-oracle success need not establish complete semantic security
Some specialized baselines cannot be reproduced

title: GraphMind: From Operational Traces to Self-Evolving Workflow Automation
problem: Operational expertise in resolution traces is expensive to retrieve and does not automatically improve workflow execution.
assumption_broken: Workflow knowledge can be an execution-reinforced action graph rather than static documents or manually authored skills.
operational_signature: Extract actions → traverse and execute → score trajectory → reinforce graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Quality-gated reinforcement and temporal decay bias subsequent retrieval toward successful action paths.
limitations_evident: Only 19 incidents receive blind expert review
Reinforcement can over-concentrate on frequent paths
Negative trajectories are not yet used for reinforcement

title: EXG: Self-Evolving Agents with Experience Graphs
problem: Task-local reflections and fragmented memories prevent immediate reuse of successes and failure repairs across tasks.
assumption_broken: Online experience can remain directly reusable offline without a separate consolidation pipeline.
operational_signature: Abstract outcome → link cases → retrieve corrective hints → execute and extend graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Typed similarity and correction edges connect warning cases to successful repairs for bounded failure-aware retrieval.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses short horizons with at most one retry
Offline construction and test separation are not visible
Persistent graph growth may require additional long-term curation

title: AtlasVA: Self-Evolving Visual Skill Memory for Teacher-Free VLM Agents
problem: Text-only memories lose geometric information and provide poorly grounded feedback for spatial policy learning.
assumption_broken: Experience and learning rewards can share evolving visual spatial priors without a proprietary language-model teacher.
operational_signature: Accumulate trajectories → update spatial priors → shape rewards → optimize and repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-derived danger and affinity atlases jointly supply visual memory and dense policy-learning rewards.

improver_modified.how: Evolving trajectory-derived atlases alter the dense reward signal used for subsequent policy optimization.

limitations_evident: Training uses privileged simulator state
Unseen-layout inference still requires geometric heuristic fields
2.5D projection limits occluded egocentric robotics

title: SkillsVote: Lifecycle Governance of Agent Skills from Collection, Recommendation to Evolution
problem: Unfiltered skill exposure and misattributed execution lessons pollute growing reusable skill libraries.
assumption_broken: Successful trajectories should not automatically authorize library updates; reusable contributions require attribution and admissibility checks.
operational_signature: Search skills → execute task → attribute reusable success → gate and route edits
load_bearing_mechanism: Subtask-level attribution admits only successful reusable exploration and routes minimal edits or new-skill creation.
limitations_evident: Recommender capability limits large-pool routing
Skill gains are heavy-tailed and can cause negative transfer
Online task-stream results are not frozen-library held-out evaluation

title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
problem: Memory evaluations do not jointly separate within-episode and cross-episode adaptation from knowledge and execution demands.
assumption_broken: A single memory representation or aggregate task score need not characterize adaptive memory effectiveness.
operational_signature: Partition memory demands → update experience sequentially → freeze for transfer → compare accuracy and cost
load_bearing_mechanism: A two-axis standardized benchmark isolates memory scope and content while comparing explicit memory against strong long-context baselines.
limitations_evident: A benchmark rather than a new memory-update algorithm
Execution experience is accumulated within dataset subsets
Full repeated-seed uncertainty is not visible
